issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 correction requesting the FHIR-core extensibility registry column labeled Description be changed to Title because it showed the computable extension name rather than an extension description.
initial_application: The issue was applied in db9355a66d, a bundled extension-registry improvement commit that explicitly listed GF#18396. The generator diff removed the separate Description header and column, changed the first column to Identity, and moved description text to the link title attribute; the Jira comment describes this as removing the useless column.
additional_context: The old source/extensibility-registry.html page was deleted by 4118eb9ddb with the explanation that the content moved to the Extensions IG. The current FHIR Extension Pack registry source uses a generated extension-list include and documents Identity, Card., Type, Context, WG, Status, and delta columns, with no obsolete Description column found in that reviewed registry source. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No current FHIR core source edit is needed because the original column problem was historically applied and the remaining registry presentation is outside this core checkout.
